All instruction ranges use TurboFan code printed in the same process as the raw tick log
Short blocks include station.head load through its conditional mismatch branch
Wide blocks include bucket load, station key pointer load, canonical-key vector loads, equality reduction and mismatch branch
Samples show where execution was observed, not cache misses, branch mispredictions, or retired-instruction counts
observedChanges: Short XOR replaced a five-instruction equality block with seven instructions including boolean materialization; parse native instruction size remained 11932 bytes
Wide single-mask replaced two movemasks plus scalar AND with vector AND plus one movemask; its block shrank from 13 instructions / 76 bytes to 12 instructions / 73 bytes
The full process_long native instruction size decreased from 1484 to 1480 bytes; parse_chunk remained 11932 bytes
Wide single-mask reversed the two canonical-vector load/compare orders, so it changes scheduling as well as removing one movemask
